releaseNotes: Album Metadata Rescue replaces unreliable one-track auto-fill with full-disc matching for CD-rip folders. It ranks exact-track-count MusicBrainz releases from the complete duration sequence, shows every before/after track mapping, and applies an approved album with one Android permission prompt. Existing year, genre, and artwork are preserved and filled only when missing. Single-track search now uses duration and track-position context.
